title: Polyglot SampleKit: unified retry + streaming adapters for Next.js / FastAPI / Go / CLI
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact, opinionated sample kit repo that demonstrates best-practice integrations with Redwood SDKs across three environments: Next.js web app, FastAPI backend, and a small Go HTTP server + CLI. The kit focuses on: 1) a single retry/backoff middleware pattern that maps to each language SDK; 2) ergonomic streaming helpers (resumable iterator in Python, async iterable in TypeScript, chunk-parsing helper in Go); 3) minimal telemetry examples showing token-level cost logging and retry metrics; and 4) cookbook snippets for common patterns (prompt templates, structured outputs, function calling). Goal: provide teams a ready-to-fork repo that reduces integration time and demonstrates production-grade defaults.
acceptance_criteria:
- Repo with 4 example apps: nextjs-ssr-chat, fastapi-worker, go-http-proxy, cli-tool.
- Each app uses the official Redwood SDK for its language and implements the shared retry/backoff strategy (exponential backoff + jitter, max 3 retries for idempotent calls, idempotency token support shown).
- Streaming examples show resumable consumption and client-side cancellation.
- README includes end-to-end quickstart (deploy locally), cost logging snippet, and a short security consideration section.
- CI runs basic lint/tests and a smoke test that hits a mocked Redwood endpoint.
- PR merged and demo recorded for onboarding.
tasks: Define canonical retry middleware & implement in Python/TS/Go
Implement streaming adapters for each SDK
Add token-level cost logging & metrics example
Write README, quickstart, and cookbook snippets
Set up CI smoke tests and linting
Record 8-minute demo video and prepare short slide deck
notes: Design decision (2026-02-25): standardize on an 'adapter' surface that maps native streaming to a small portable interface: asyncIterable<T> for TS, Iterator[T] with resume token for Python, channel-based chunk parser for Go.
Trade-off: keeping examples small beats exhaustive coverage. We will link to deeper SDK docs for advanced config (batching, quantization).
Security: ensure examples default to environment-based API keys and show note on never committing keys. Add short KMS note in README for Private customers.
testing_notes: CI includes a local mock server that simulates partial stream failures (connection reset) and server-side 5xx to validate retry behavior. Tests assert that: 1) idempotent calls are retried with jitter, 2) streaming resumes when a resume token is provided, 3) telemetry emits retry_count and token_cost metrics. Use pytest for Python, jest for TS, and go test for Go.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge PRs to main under samplekit-polyglot repo. 2) Feature-flag the demo site behind 'samplekit-demo' org flag for internal preview. 3) Run an internal demo session with Developer Experience and Solutions Engineers. 4) Publish public README and add a short tutorial to the docs hub. 5) Monitor adoption via repo forks and track inbound feedback for follow-up tickets.
